description: Roll 9 story dice covered in symbols — then weave every symbol into an improvised story. A creativity workout for writers and kids.

faqs.a: Nine dice, each with 6 faces — 54 symbols total, from 🚀 and 🐉 to 🗝️ and 🌈.
faqs.q: How many dice and symbols are there?

faqs.a: Tap any single die to re-roll just that one while keeping the rest.
Yes — use the generated prompt line as a story starter and copy it.
faqs.q: Does it give me a story prompt?

faqs.a: Yes — big tappable dice, fully mobile friendly.

howto: Make up a story that uses every symbol.
Tap a single die to re-roll it, or copy the prompt.
title: Story Dice Roller
